name: jy-weekly-downloader
description: Creates a per-user scheduled task that downloads JY weekly Excel files with a local script.

displayDescription.en: Schedules a local script to save the JY equity and futures weekly workbooks into the current user's own folder.
displayDescription.zh: 为当前用户定时下载 JY 跟踪池股票和期货周报 Excel，保存到他自己的目录。

defaultInitPrompt.en: Set up a Thursday 16:30 task to download the JY equity and futures weekly Excel files into my Documents folder.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我建一个每周四 16:30 的定时任务，把 JY 跟踪池股票和期货周报 Excel 下载到我的文档目录。

quickPrompts.en: Set up a Thursday 16:30 task to download the JY equity and futures weekly Excel files into my Documents folder.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我建一个每周四 16:30 的定时任务，把 JY 跟踪池股票和期货周报 Excel 下载到我的文档目录。

quickPrompts.en: Save the weekly workbooks to a folder I choose, and skip a file when that week is already there.
quickPrompts.zh: 周报保存到我指定的文件夹，同一周的文件已经在就跳过。
